_comments: The BizApps Orders Application — what makes this app a first-class citizen of MJ Explorer
rather than a set of loose dashboards.
DefaultNavItems is the top tab bar, and it is the information architecture: four sections
organised by JOB rather than by entity. Fifty-one tables would otherwise be fifty-one
destinations, leaving the user to assemble the workflow in their head.
Each item is ResourceType 'Custom' pointing at a DriverClass registered with
components owns a LEFT navigation rail over its own sub-pages — MJ's rule is top nav across
sections, left nav within one, and these four are the sections.
Orders is the default tab because taking an order is the job most people open this app to do.
Every generated entity form remains reachable for admin work; it is simply not the navigation.
The fixed UUID means a re-push against a rebuilt database updates this row rather than creating
a second Application with the same name.

fields.Name: Orders
fields.Description: Order entry, payments, receivables and the product catalog. The confirmed order is the receivable — there is no separate invoice — so billing, collections and revenue recognition all read the same record the order taker created.
